data.name: The Eventide
data.detailed_description:
We see the world as we need to; not as it is.

There are planes of existence adjacent to our own. Unknown to most, but not to The Eventide Agency: a covert team of investigators tasked with monitoring, studying, and, when necessary, intervening in supernatural events.

No two events are the same, and neither are the investigations. Following an anonymous tip, the agents open a case file on a seemingly routine haunting. But one case quickly becomes many, scattered across the city. Each with a different story. Each with a different truth. 

Every case in The Eventide begins with a question: who should investigate? The choice matters. A backlog of unexplained incidents waits for your attention. Each day, you select one case and assign two agents to investigate it. Every agent sees the world differently - and that difference determines what the case reveals.

The city doesn't reveal its secrets easily. From rain-slicked city alleys to dusty libraries and abandoned radio stations, your chosen agents investigate each scene through unique abilities. The agents move through investigations differently - drawn to different details, asking different questions. Every clue they uncover adds to a shared case notebook, building a picture that neither agent could have assembled alone.

The evidence is collected. What it means is still yours to determine. Your agents return with clues - fragments of something that happened, or something that still lingers. You piece it together, filling in the gaps of a case report that only you can complete. Each resolved case opens new leads, new locations, and new questions.

The truth is never lost - it persists, in this world, or another. Welcome, to the Eventide Agency.

FEATURES

  • A neon-noir supernatural conspiracy

  • Unique paranormal investigators

  • An eerie, ambient original soundtrack

  • Perspective-led deductive gameplay

  • Haunting, atmospheric 3D environments

data.short_description: A supernatural mystery where perspective informs reality. Guide agents from the Eventide Agency through paranormal investigations across a neon-soaked cityscape. Explore, collect clues, and interpret the evidence to uncover the facts of each case and expose a deeper truth.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of death, supernatural phenomena, and the aftermath of violence encountered during paranormal investigations. Content is presented within the context of case reconstruction and investigation rather than direct gameplay action. Some cases contain mature narrative themes including loss, illness, grief, and trauma.
